name: Joy for All Orange Tabby Cat
description: A stationary, lifelike orange-and-white companion cat from Ageless Innovation — purrs and "meows" to touch and sound, with a vibrating "VibraPurr" response to petting. Sibling product to the Companion Pet Pup, aimed at the same senior loneliness and dementia-care market.

specs.label: Dimensions
specs.note: ~3.9 lb (per mfr., same spec as the dog)

specs.label: Response
specs.note: touch and sound sensors, no BarkBack-style brand name

specs.label: Behaviors
specs.note: auto-sleep after inactivity, wakes on touch

specs.label: Variants
specs.note: also Silver With White Mitts, Tuxedo

specs.label: Power
specs.note: alkaline; life "varies," ~3 mo. per reviewer estimates

specs.label: Subscription
specs.note: battery-powered, no app or connectivity — Ageless Innovation FAQ

sourcing: Verified against Ageless Innovation's own site and FAQ, retailer listings and reviews (Amazon, Walmart, Best Buy), and category-wide press on Ageless Innovation's state and healthcare partnerships. No cat-specific breakout exists for state-program adoption stats — those figures are category-wide, not cat-versus-dog. The cat's heartbeat feature is corroborated by a third-party retailer rather than directly confirmed on the primary manufacturer product page. Battery life (~3 months) is an unofficial reviewer estimate, not a manufacturer figure. Dimensions/weight are identical to the Companion Pet Pup per the manufacturer's own FAQ despite the different sculpted pose.

pricing.summary: Ageless Innovation's own site lists $159.99 for Orange Tabby. Retailers run lower and less consistently in stock — Walmart and Best Buy have both shown $124.99, with Walmart currently out of stock and Best Buy's listing marked "no longer available in new condition." Treat pricing as roughly $125–$160 depending on retailer and current stock, similar in pattern to the Companion Pet Pup but running somewhat lower.

editorial.heading: Insights
editorial.body: Ageless Innovation's own FAQ states this cat shares identical published dimensions and weight with the Companion Pet Pup (15.24 × 9.02 × 10.12 in., 3.9 lb), despite the two toys having very different sculpted poses. That's a real, manufacturer-stated figure worth treating with some skepticism, since it more plausibly reflects a shared packaging spec than an actual to-scale body measurement for the cat.

firmwareCommunity.note: Joy for All Orange Tabby Cat has not released a public SDK, firmware repo, or developer API. Not currently listed in Builds & Mods.
